name: new_v1_f4d_manus_multiuser_session_context_v1
source_state: Each user's session-1 trials fit fixed bands and an equal-trial-weighted long spectral reference. In session 2/3, only the six medium-speed gesture trials set the equal-trial-weighted current reference; distinct slow/fast trials are evaluation-only. No target evaluation update.
scope: Public same-user, multi-session, eight-channel 200 Hz F4d context diagnostic. Speed and session are confounded; the current reference is gesture-balanced but medium-speed-specific. This is neither a fatigue measurement nor a predictive accuracy or own-device calendar-day claim.
